title: PDF text: Chinese, Japanese and Korean text is drawn as boxes without a system font for it
symptom: by default a system font draws the Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters the bundled fonts lack (their CJK faces hold a few characters only); on a machine with no such font, and always with bundled fonts only, the glyphs are empty boxes, and a diagnostic names the script, the number of characters and the way out
workaround: install a CJK font, or pass a CJK font file (Rust to_pdf_with_fonts, or to_pdfa_with_fonts_deterministic for PDF/A; Python to_pdf(fonts=...) or font_dir=...; CLI convert --font-dir); none for PDF/A in Python and the CLI
